metadata.title: Superwhisper — AI Voice to Text for macOS, Windows, iOS & Android

selected_lines: Superwhisper works offline, so you can transcribe anytime.
Set custom shortcuts to launch, dictate and control.
Create modes designed for your tasks, whether you're writing a message, a document, speaking another language...
Custom Mode lets you define how Superwhisper thinks, writes, and formats. Down to the finest detail.
Allow agents to one shot your next feature by giving them more context. Talk through your change and skip the typing.
[![QR code for the iOS and Android downloads](https://superwhisper.com/image/mobile-download-qr.svg)](https://superwhisper.com/mobile)
Take Superwhisper with you on iOS and Android. Keep your tone, punctuation, and formatting consistent wherever you go.
